description: This file provides a SwiftUI View extension to track and respond to width changes of a view using preferences and preference keys. It also includes a debugging utility for testing width reduction logic.

classes.name: ViewWidthPreferenceKey
classes.description: A PreferenceKey implementation that captures the maximum width of a View.

classes.name: ViewMetricsTesting
classes.description: A utility enum included only in debug builds for testing width reduction logic.

methods.name: onWidthChange
methods.description: A View extension method that executes a closure whenever the width of the view changes.
